title: M-Node Lagrange-Richardson Zero-Noise Extrapolation Bias vs. Shot-Noise Penalty
claims: M-node Lagrange-Richardson extrapolation on integer stretch factors lambda_k = k + 1 has closed-form weights c_k = (-1)^k C(M+1, k+1) satisfying sum c_k = 1 and sum c_k lambda_k^j = 0 (1 <= j <= M), reducing dephasing bias to O((alpha*h)^{M+1}).
The L1 weight norm equals sum |c_k| = 2^{M+1} - 1, inducing an exact (2^{M+1} - 1)^2 optimal-shot variance penalty.
favorable_controls: Orders M=0, 1, 2, 3 at alpha*h = 0.10 (>115x bias suppression at M=2) and alpha*h = 0.25
